question: The original's single-player lobby (tfh/interface/lobby.gui `lobby`): the tabs and lists, a bookmark row and a save row, how a country is chosen, the selected-country panel, Play and Back.

addresses.name: CBookmarkEntry::CBookmarkEntry
addresses.no_signature: ret 0x14 (five stack arguments) with the gui in ECX; Ghidra shows seven parameters (gui, a value from the screen's slot 16, the object, the window name, the CBookmark, the CGameSetup, the custom-game byte) and which of the remaining ones travels in a register was not settled at the call sites, so none is offered.
addresses.comment: **A row of the lobby's `bookmarks_list` (and of `cgm_bookmarks`' copy).** A 0x88-byte CStandardlistboxItem: the window `bookmark_entry` [mod: temp_frontend.gui] made through the gui (+0x20); the CBookmark at +0x28; the CGameSetup at +0x80 and the custom-game byte at +0x84; its button `bookmark` kept at +0x2C and given the CButtonObserverGlue at +0x30 whose click is CBookmarkEntry::OnBookmarkClicked. **The button's sprite is the bookmark's `icon`** (button slot 57, +0xE4, with CBookmark +0x78) where the icon is not empty; `title` gets the bookmark's localised name (CBookmark +8) and `date` FormatHourDate(CBookmark +0xA4) - ` %d:00, %d %s, %d`. Two callers, both in CGameSetup::BuildBookmarkLists (0x308D57 for historical starts, custom-game byte 0; 0x3090E7 for custom-game bookmarks, byte 1). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontend.md section B.2.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled in a copy of the project (DecompileAt): the stores to +0x28/+0x2C/+0x80/+0x84, the glue constructed with 0x7034F0 as its first handler, the 'bookmark', 'title' and 'date' lookups with FUN_006EC690 (returns CBookmark +8) and FormatHourDate(+0xA4). ret 0x14 read off 0x70340D. What would show it wrong: a second constructor of the same vftable (findRefs --vftable CBookmarkEntry finds the store only here).

addresses.name: CBookmarkEntry::Update
addresses.comment: Slot 9 of CBookmarkEntry's second table (object offset 0x1C, TListboxItem), so `this` is the row + 0x1C. Run every frame for every row: **the button's frame is 2 (shown chosen) when the bookmark's name equals CGameSetup::GetStartName and the row's custom-game byte equals CGameSetup +0x6F8, else 1** - which is how the chosen bookmark is highlighted; nothing else. Bare ret.
addresses.evidence: vtable.py --holding 0x703410: one table, CBookmarkEntry @0x1C slot 9. Decompiled: String_Equals(setup slot 9's text, bookmark name) and the byte compare against setup +0x6F8, then button slot 18 (+0x48) with 2 or 1. Offsets read as row+0x1C+N match the constructor's +0x80 setup, +0x28 bookmark, +0x2C button, +0x84 byte. Wrong if slot 9 of that table were not called per frame (it is the list item's Update in CWindowForLoadedUnitsEntry@0x1C too).

addresses.name: CBookmarkEntry::OnBookmarkClicked
addresses.comment: **A click on a bookmark row**: a 0x104-byte CSelectBookmark made from the row's CBookmark (+0x28) through 0x6D4F70 and posted on the session's channel (session +0x38, slot 6). Nothing else - the selection itself happens when the command executes (CSelectBookmark::Execute -> CFrontEnd::SelectBookmark -> CGameSetup::SelectBookmark). Bare ret.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; the glue that calls it is built in CBookmarkEntry::CBookmarkEntry with this address as its click handler. findRefs --callers 0x6D4F70 finds two callers, this (0x70352E) and CGameSetup::SelectDefaultBookmark (0x7080D4).

addresses.name: CBookmarkEntry_DisableButton
addresses.comment: The row's `bookmark` button given state 3 (button slot 45, +0xB4) - inferred to be the greyed look. CGameSetup::BuildBookmarkLists calls it for every historical-start row when the session mode global (0x1A85618) is neither 0 nor 1, i.e. on a multiplayer client, who cannot choose the start. `ret 4`.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole (FindButton 'bookmark', slot 45 with 3); the caller's mode test read in BuildBookmarkLists. What state 3 draws as was not read - that is the inference; the custom-game rows get the same call inlined.

addresses.name: CSavegameItem::CSavegameItem
addresses.signature: CSavegameItem* __stdcall CSavegameItem::CSavegameItem(CSavegameItem* this, Hoi3CString* fileName, CGameSetup* setup, CFrontEnd* frontEnd)
addresses.comment: **The lobby's save-list row, and the only reader of a save's header.** Writes CStandardlistboxItem's and then CSavegameItem's vftable, makes the `savegameentry` window, shows the file name before `.hoi3` as `title`, opens `save games/<file>` (`mod/<mod>/save games/` under a mod) and reads **positionally**: the first key=value's value is taken as the date whatever its key and shown as `date`; the second, when it is `scenario`, is looked up (ScenarioList_FindByName; a miss logs `loading scenario that doesnt exist: `) and the next pair read; then, when that pair is `player`, its tag gives the row's `shield` and is kept at +0x44/+0x48. So **a save whose first key is not `date`, or whose `player` is not second (third after `scenario`), shows a wrong date or no shield in the original's list.** One caller, 0x715A78, the lobby's `save_games_list` fill. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md section C.2. **Arguments and fields, read 2026-11-06**: 0xC8 bytes (the caller's operator_new(200)); the file name copied to +0x28; +0x44 the save's player tag (`---` until read) and +0x48 its id; +0x4C the date (the null date until read; FormatHourDate's ` %d:00, %d %s, %d` is what `date` shows); +0x50 the CGameSetup and +0x54 the CFrontEnd it was given; +0xA8 the 'loaded' byte (CSavegameItem::SetLoaded); +0xAC the scenario name. Where there is no `player`, the shield is set to nothing (button slot 53 with no country). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontend.md section B.3.
addresses.revises: Adds the signature the old entry declined to give - the caller (CGameSetup::OnSavedGamesTab, 0x715A78) passes the 200-byte block, a pointer to the file name out of the listing vector, the CGameSetup and the CGameSetup's +4 (the CFrontEnd) - and the field list; the old comment is kept word for word.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled the constructor and its caller in a copy of the project: the stores param_1[0x14] = setup, [0x15] = frontEnd, [0x11] = '---', [0x13] = null date; ret 0x10 (four stack arguments) as the old no_signature already said. CSavegameItem::OnClicked reads +0x50's slot 5 and +0x54's slot 18, which is what types those two. The pushes read on the listing at 0x715A71-0x715A78: [setup+4], setup, the name, the block.

addresses.name: CSavegameItem::OnClicked
addresses.comment: Slot 4 of CSavegameItem's primary table - a click on the row (as CCountrySelectionItem's slot 4 is). **Before the save is loaded** (+0xA8 clear) or when the header had no `player` (+0x48 = 0): only ticks the row's `save_game` checkbox if it is not ticked (0xA820F0) and tells the checkbox's observers, which is CGameSetup::OnSaveRowChecked - so a click anywhere on the row does what a click on its checkbox does. **After it is loaded, with a player**: the CGameSetup's OnProvinceClicked (+0x50, slot 5) with the capital of the save's player, the screen centred on that capital (CentreOnProvince), and - where the local human (FindHumanById with the session's +0x6C) is not already playing the save's player - a CSetCountryControllerCommand(save's player, the state's current player, the human) posted. CGameSetup::Update calls it for the loaded row in single player (mode 0) once the load is done, **which is how the save's `player` becomes the chosen country.** Two bare rets (0x70483B, 0x7049DD).
addresses.evidence: vtable.py --holding 0x704560: one table, CSavegameItem slot 4. Decompiled whole; the observer walk is the checkbox's +0x4C list with each observer's slot 4. The Update call site (the loop over save_games_list comparing +0x28 with +0x698 and calling slot 4) read in the same decompilation. Wrong if slot 4 were not the click - the walk-the-observers branch would make no sense for anything else.

addresses.name: CSavegameItem::SetLoaded
addresses.comment: Slot 7 of CSavegameItem's primary table: `mov [ecx+0xA8], arg; ret 4`. CGameSetup::OnSaveRowChecked sets it on the clicked row and clears it on every other, so +0xA8 means 'this row's save is the chosen one' and CSavegameItem::OnClicked tests it.
addresses.evidence: Bytes read; vtable.py --holding 0x7049E0 finds one table (CSavegameItem slot 7), so no fold (trap 4). The two calls with 1 and 0 read in OnSaveRowChecked's decompilation.

addresses.name: CGameSetup::CGameSetup
addresses.no_signature: ret 8 with the object as Ghidra's param_1; Ghidra also invents a `this`, and whether a register carries something was not settled, so no signature is offered.
addresses.comment: **The lobby's constructor.** Writes the five tables (0x15D59C0, +8 0x15D59FC, +0xC 0x15D5A0C, +0x3C 0x15D5A50, +0x6C 0x15D5A80), builds the gui window `lobby` [mod: tfh/interface/lobby.gui] into +0x3B8, and the button glues: +0x188 Back (CGameSetup::OnBack), +0x1D8 Play (CGameSetup::OnPlay), +0x228 victoryconditions_button (CGameSetup::OnVictoryConditionsButton), +0x130 `singleplayer`'s `player_shield` (CGameSetup::OnPlayerShieldClicked), +0x4D0 newgame_tab (OnNewGameTab), +0x520 savedgame_tab (OnSavedGamesTab), +0x570 scenario_tab (OnScenariosTab), +0x5C0 cgm_tab (OnCustomGamesTab), +0x660 the save rows' checkbox glue (OnSaveRowChecked), +0x368 the start-date shields' glue (OnShortcutShieldClicked); play_button and victoryconditions_button get their byte +0x61 = 1. +0x464/+0x468 = the defines' start_date and end_date. Also the difficulty (FE_DIFFICULTY, DIFF_VERY_EASY..DIFF_VERY_HARD) and game-mode (FE_ARCADE, STANDARD_MODE/ARCADE_MODE) choosers, the six automation settings (FE_SETTING_*; OPT_PLAYER_CONTROL/OPT_AICONTROL and, for the fifth, OPT_AI_CORP..OPT_AI_THEATER) of `interface/options.gui`'s `option_window` (+0x700) - their state read from the game state - and the victory conditions window `victory_conditions_window` (+0x8B0). `ret 8`.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled in a copy of the project; the glue offsets read off the disassembly (lea eax,[ebx+N] before each 0x71AB80 call, the handler as its first or thirteenth argument) and matched to the elements by the FindButton(...)->+0x48 slot 1 calls that take this+N (the decompiler shows param_1 + 0x134 etc. as int indices). The one inference is that the +0x368 glue's thirteenth-argument handler is the click - it is the only handler that glue has.

addresses.name: CGameSetup::Prepare
addresses.comment: Slot 1 of CFrontEndView (pure there), called by the front end's view switch (0x6F1280) as the lobby becomes the current view (CFrontEnd +0x750[3] is the CGameSetup). Clears the chosen start (+0x6DC name, +0x6F8, +0x6FC); +0x6C8 = the application's +0x130 (inferred an online/metaserver link; zero in a plain single-player game); **in single player (mode global 0x1A85618 = 0)** MarkSimulatedProvinces(state, 0) and the custom-game settings emptied; the `multiplayer` window's `checksum` text set; CGameSetup_RefreshYearLabel; in single player the session's slot 2 (0, 0) and `lobby_chat_edit` hidden, otherwise shown; a CAddPlayer for the local player record (+0x410); then CGameSetup_SyncOptionsFromGameState, 0x708190 (the session joined - the chat line `CONNECTED`), and **+0x6C7 (a save loaded) cleared**. Bare ret. Named after CFrontEndView's slot (Prepare, Show, Hide) where the two front-end readers of 2026-11-06 met on it.
addresses.evidence: vtable.py: CGameSetup slot 1 only. Decompiled whole. The view-switch body at 0x6F1280 (old view slot 3, index stored at +0x760, new view slots 1 then 2) read on the listing; that CFrontEnd's views[3] is this class rests on CFrontEnd slots 84/86 forwarding to views[3] slots 7/10, which only CGameSetup has. Ghidra's plate comment calls this CGameSetup::Save - a CPersistent name left on the primary table by the bug trap 4 describes; CGameSetup's CPersistent family is at +0xC.

addresses.name: CGameSetup::SelectDefaultBookmark
addresses.comment: **What the lobby shows on opening in single player or as host** (called at the end of CGameSetup::BuildBookmarkLists when the mode global is 0 or 1). Clears the chosen start; MarkSimulatedProvinces(state, 0); the custom-game settings emptied; **history executed from the state's tick to the defines' start_date** (ExecuteHistoryToDate on the registry at 0x1A88BC0, then tick = +0x464); RefreshAllCountries; the map's overlays hidden and its colours redrawn; then **a CSelectBookmark for the first historical bookmark in the list** (bookmarks.txt order) posted. So the first bookmark of the file is selected when the lobby opens. Bare ret.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; the list head is *[0x1A8A874] and CBookmarkList_Load appends at the tail (+0xCC next), so the head is the file's first non-custom bookmark. findRefs --callers: one call, 0x709582 in BuildBookmarkLists.

addresses.name: CGameSetup::Show
addresses.comment: Slot 2 of CFrontEndView, called by the view switch after Enter. The front end's own window (CFrontEnd +0x730) hidden and the lobby window (+0x3B8) shown; in single player (mode 0) `lobby_chat_edit` hidden; `chatlog` scrolled; **CGameSetup::OnNewGameTab** - so the lobby opens on the Historical Start tab; then the four tab buttons enabled (button slot 46) - or, on a multiplayer client, disabled (slot 47). Bare ret.
addresses.evidence: vtable.py: CGameSetup slot 2 only. Decompiled whole; the call to 0x715100 and the two arms on the mode global read. Ghidra's plate comment calls it CGameSetup::SaveContents (trap 4's leftover, as for slot 1).

addresses.name: CGameSetup::BuildBookmarkLists
addresses.comment: Slot 13 of CGameSetup. Clears the chosen start and MarkSimulatedProvinces(state, 0), empties the custom-game settings and the lists `multiplayer_list`, `chatlog`, `bookmarks_list` (in `bookmarks`) and `bookmarks_list` (in `cgm_bookmarks`); **one CBookmarkEntry per bookmark, in list order** - the historical list (*[0x1A8A874]) into `bookmarks`, the custom-game list ([0x1A8A874]+0x10) into `cgm_bookmarks` - each greyed on a multiplayer client (CBookmarkEntry_DisableButton). Then slot 10 (ClearBookmark), the gui refreshed, the lobby's transfer state reset (+0x698 = '', +0x6B4..), the session's pending-transfer globals cleared, and in single player or as host (mode 0 or 1) **CGameSetup::SelectDefaultBookmark**. Bare ret. Single player's button calls it before the lobby is shown (FINDINGS-frontend.md, A.2).
addresses.evidence: vtable.py: CGameSetup slot 13 only. Decompiled whole: two loops over the list via +0xCC, CBookmarkEntry constructed with the custom-game byte 0 and 1, each added with the list box's slot 4 (+0x10, (item, 1)). Who calls slot 13 was not found (it is virtual; no slotcalls run) - so when the lists are rebuilt is the open point.

addresses.name: CGameSetup::Hide
addresses.comment: Slot 3 of CFrontEndView, called by the view switch on the view being left: the lobby window hidden, 0x6F1320, and each start-date shield (+0x46C list) hidden. Bare ret. Named after CFrontEndView's slot (Prepare, Show, Hide) where the two front-end readers of 2026-11-06 met on it.
addresses.evidence: vtable.py: CGameSetup slot 3 only; decompiled whole (three calls). The view switch at 0x6F1280 calls the old view's slot 3 before storing the new index. Ghidra's plate comment calls it CGameSetup::Load (trap 4's leftover).

addresses.name: CGameSetup::Update
addresses.comment: Slot 4 of CGameSetup, the pre-game lobby (gamesetup.cpp), and **where a savegame is loaded - in the lobby, before Play**; CFrontEnd::LaunchGame loads nothing. All three arms run only while +0x6C4 is set (a load pending, inferred) and clear the byte 0x1A857BF around the parse. (1) **The server - a single-player game, or a multiplayer host** (session +0x34 set, inferred to mean 'server'; 0x30B08B): once every other player's transfer reports done and while +0x6C5 (loaded) is clear, Session::PumpCommands, then LoadSaveFile on `save games/<+0x698>` (`mod/<mod>/save games/<name>` under a mod), CGameSetup_SyncOptionsFromGameState, and the lobby lines `SAVE_TRANSFER_DONE` and `SAVE_LOADED`. (2) **A multiplayer client whose own copy matches** - the transfer (+0x6D8) names the same file and its +0xB0 equals +0x6B4 (0x30B73C): LoadSaveFile on its local file, the sync, +0x6C5 and +0x6C7 set, RefreshAllCountries, the front end's map refreshed (0x641D90, 0x641D50), the settings' +0xF0 = 0xFF9A and +0xF4 = 2, +0x6C4 cleared and the transfer deleted. (3) **Any other client** (0x30BA34): logs `Received `, builds a stream over the bytes the transfer holds and calls CGameState::LoadFromSave on it directly, the same refreshes with Map_RefreshColourTextures, and **writes the received bytes to its own `save games/<name>`**. It also fills the lobby's labels (`selected_nation_label`, `head_of_state`, `wars_label`, `play_button`, `victoryconditions_button`). The played country is not set here: it comes from the CSetCountryControllerCommand the lobby posts, whose Execute (CSetCountryControllerCommand slot 6) writes state->player and played_countries. The name is inference: the body is the lobby's per-frame work by its PumpCommands and pending-flag shape. **Read further 2026-11-06** (FINDINGS-frontend.md B.4-B.6): the server arm sets +0x6C7 (a save loaded) before it walks the players, and after the load, **in single player (mode 0) calls the loaded row's CSavegameItem::OnClicked**, which selects the save's `player`. Every frame, besides: CGameSetup_RefreshYearLabel when the state's tick differs from +0x460; **the `singleplayer` panel rebuilt when +0x4CC or the state's controllers_changed (+0xC0) is set**, from the local human (the state's human list, +0x1C equal to +0x42C): with no country the panel hidden and its texts emptied; otherwise `player_shield` the country's shield, `selected_nation_label` CountryNameOfTag, `selected_fog` **the government's display name** (CGovernment slot GetDisplayName - 'form of government'), `icon_factions` shown with the faction's frame where the country's faction answers its slot 7, else hidden, `head_of_state` the name (+0x30) of the minister in the government position `head_of_state`, `photo_head_of_state` `gfx/pictures/portraits/<picture>.tga` with `GFX_empty_position` behind, and `wars_label` **`ATWAR` ("At War.") where any diplomacy status has a war, else `ATPEACE`** - the enemies are listed into +0x48C but not written into the text. **play_button** enabled (slot 46) when CGameSetup_CanStart holds - and, unless the session's lobby_reopened (+0x236) is set, the session's +0x34 too - else disabled (slot 47); **victoryconditions_button** enabled only when no save is loaded (+0x6C7 clear) and 0x71C560 answers yes; and when the front end's +0x764 (start requested) is set and CanStart holds, **CGameSetup_StartGame**.
addresses.revises: Keeps the old text and adds what the frame does besides loading: the panel's content and its trigger, the two buttons' enabling, the start request, and the single-player row click after a load.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole in a copy of the project (DecompileAt, 0x709C90); the tail 0x70BE8D-0x70C0A3 read on the listing for the enable/disable choice (slot 0xB8 = 46 enable, 0xBC = 47 disable, as the record has them for buttons elsewhere). The panel strings and calls are the decompiler's; ATWAR/ATPEACE texts from the install's localisation. What would show the panel reading wrong: a second writer of selected_fog (string refs: two, both here).

addresses.name: CGameSetup::OnProvinceClicked
addresses.comment: Slot 5 of CFrontEndView - **how a country is chosen on the map**. The front end's per-frame update calls the current view's slot 5 (0x6EE864) with the province under the pointer for a mouse-button event the interface did not take, and only where that province's owner_id (+0x330) is not 0. Here: where the owner id is not 0 and **either no scenario is set or the scenario's country list contains it** (CountryIdListContains), a CSetCountryControllerCommand(owner tag/id, the state's current player, the session's local human id) is posted, and the sound `click` played. **No other test**: not whether a save is loaded, not REB, not whether the country is someone else's - so after a save is loaded a click still changes the country. `ret 4`.
addresses.evidence: vtable.py: CGameSetup slot 5 only (CFrontEndView's own slot 5 is the shared stub 0x60CD50). Decompiled whole; the call site read on the listing at 0x6EE84F-0x6EE864 (views[+0x760] slot 5, after the pick at 0x8558F0 and the owner_id test). Which mouse button: the event's +0x10 == 3 test before it was not decoded into a button - see the findings' open list.

addresses.name: CGameSetup::OnBack
addresses.comment: **`back_button`'s handler** (glue +0x188). Where +0x6C8 (the online link) is set, the online leave messages first. Then a CAddPlayer for the local player record posted; Session::PumpCommands; the session's slot 2 and its channel's slot 3; the options window (+0x700) hidden; 0x717D60 (the option choices posted); on a client (mode not 0) 0x70E3D0; **ResetGameStateToStartDate(true)**; +0x180 = 0; and the front end switched **to view 0** (the settings' +0x174 cleared) in a plain game, **or to view 5** where the online link is set - the old view's slot 3, the new one's slots 1 and 2, as CFrontEnd's switch does; the victory conditions window hidden. So Back throws away a loaded save or the chosen start. Bare ret.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; the glue +0x188 is bound to 'back_button' in the constructor (0x705D28). Which screens views 0 and 5 are is the front end's business (the main menu reader's); 0 is inferred the main menu from the settings +0x174 store matching the view switch's own index-0 arm at 0x6F129D.

addresses.name: CGameSetup_CanStart
addresses.comment: **Whether Play may be pressed**, with the reason written to `reason` when it is not null. False while a load is pending (+0x6C4) or the victory conditions window is shown; false when the state has no human (+0x68), or any human has no country (+0x24 = 0) or a country owning no province; true at once where the session may not post (+0x34 clear - a client); otherwise by the tab shown: `bookmarks` - true unless a save is loaded (+0x6C7), a custom-game bookmark is chosen (+0x6F8) or a scenario (+0x6FC), which say CANT_START_REASON_SELECT_BOOKMARK; `cgm_bookmarks` - needs +0x6F8, else CANT_START_REASON_SELECT_CGM; `scenarios` - needs +0x6FC, else CANT_START_REASON_SELECT_SCENARIO; `save_games` - **needs +0x6C7 (a save loaded)**, else CANT_START_REASON_SELECT_SAVE_GAME. `ret 4`, `this` in EDI.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole (Ghidra shows `this` as unaff_EDI); the three rets are `ret 4`; the call sites in Update (0x70BEA7, 0x70BF15, 0x70C084) load EDI with this and push one argument (0 there). The tab tests are each window's +0x5B (shown) byte. Inferred rather than confirmed because the decompiler's flow for the bookmarks arm was untidy; the CANT_START keys and their order are certain.

addresses.name: CGameSetup::OnPlayerShieldClicked
addresses.comment: `singleplayer`'s `player_shield` (glue +0x130): where the country id at +0x434 (in the lobby's own player record at +0x410) is not 0 and has a capital, the front end's slot 48 (+0xC0) with that capital - inferred to centre the map. Whether +0x430/+0x434 follow the chosen country was not settled: no store to either was found in the lobby's code. Bare ret.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole (four instructions of work). The glue binding read in the constructor (FindButton 'player_shield' in 'singleplayer', glue this+0x130). The negative about +0x434 is a displacement search over 0x703000-0x71B600 for '+ 0x430]'/'+ 0x434]' (two reads, both here; positive control: the same search finds +0x42C's four uses).

addresses.name: CGameSetup::OnPlay
addresses.comment: **`play_button`'s handler** (glue +0x1D8; the button is enabled only while CGameSetup_CanStart holds). The victory conditions window hidden. Without the online link (+0x6C8 = 0): **for a new game only (not loaded_from_save)** the seed 0x174DA94 set from a clock ([0x1A857E4] slot 5, rounded) and g_random_draws = 0; the options window hidden; 0x717D60 (the difficulty, game mode and automation choices posted where they differ from the state's); where the session may post (+0x34) VictoryConditions_PostChosen; then **a CSetRandomSeed(seed, draws) and a CLobbyStartGame posted**, and the session's slot 2. With the online link, an online start message instead. Nothing launches here: CLobbyStartGame::Execute sets the front end's +0x764 and the next CGameSetup::Update calls CGameSetup_StartGame. Two bare rets.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; the glue +0x1D8 bound to 'play_button' at 0x705D81. The clock reading is the decompiler's float from [0x1A857E4] slot 5; what that object is was not read, hence 'a clock'. A loaded game posts the seed and draws the globals already hold (A.3 of FINDINGS-savegame.md: the save's own seed is dropped).

addresses.name: CGameSetup_StartGame
addresses.comment: Called by CGameSetup::Update once the front end's start request (+0x764) is set and CGameSetup_CanStart holds. Province field +0xC zeroed for every province of the country at +0x968 (custom-game business, not read); 0x68BA80 on the state; VictoryConditions_DailyCheck; on a client the session's slots; in single player a new 0x260-byte Session (`Launch`, `NoAdress`) made; the front end's slot 19; 0x644FE0(0 in single player, 1 otherwise) and **the front end's +0x765 = 1**, which its update turns into CFrontEnd::LaunchGame (the main menu reader's side). `ret 4`.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; the call site 0x70C08E pushes EDI (this) and the two rets are `ret 4`. The arms are the decompiler's and were not checked on the listing; 'turns into LaunchGame' rests on the record's note that the front end's update calls LaunchGame, not on reading +0x765's reader.

addresses.name: CGameSetup::SelectBookmark
addresses.comment: Slot 7 of CGameSetup, reached from CSelectBookmark::Execute through CFrontEnd::SelectBookmark. **+0x6C7 (save loaded) and the scenario (+0x6FC) cleared**; MarkSimulatedProvinces(state, 0); the state's +0xD2C = the bookmark's is_cgm; for a custom-game bookmark its `templates.txt` loaded into the custom-game settings. **+0x6DC = the bookmark's name, +0x6F8 = is_cgm**; **the date = the bookmark's (+0xA4) held between the defines' start_date and end_date (+0x464, +0x468)**, and where the session may post a CSetHistoryDate(date) posted - which is what moves the world. struct_fields.evidence: Constructor: param_3[0xB] = FindButton('bookmark'); Update sets its frame through +0x1C+0x10.

struct_fields.name: setup
struct_fields.comment: the lobby, asked for the chosen start in Update
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor: param_3[0x20]; Update reads it at this(+0x1C)+0x64.

struct_fields.name: is_cgm
struct_fields.comment: the row is in the custom-game list
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor: *(param_3 + 0x21) = last argument (0 or 1 by list); Update compares it with CGameSetup +0x6F8.

struct_fields.name: name
struct_fields.comment: `name`, localised (GetText of the key)
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey's `name` arm parses into +8, copies the key to +0x40, then replaces +8 with the rendered text; FUN_006EC690 returns +8.

struct_fields.name: desc
struct_fields.comment: `desc`, localised
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey's `desc` arm: +0x24, key copied to +0x5C, then rendered.

struct_fields.name: name_key
struct_fields.comment: `name` as written
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey copies the parsed name here before localising +8; SaveContents writes +0x40 as `name`.

struct_fields.name: desc_key
struct_fields.comment: `desc` as written
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey and SaveContents, as for +0x40.

struct_fields.name: icon
struct_fields.comment: `icon`: the sprite of the row's button
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey's `icon` arm ParseString(this + 0x78); CBookmarkEntry::CBookmarkEntry sets the button's sprite from +0x78 when its length (+0x88) is not 0.

struct_fields.name: countries
struct_fields.comment: the `country` tags, in order (0x14-byte id nodes, next at +0xC; tail +0x98, count +0x9C); a tag that is no country logs `Bad tag X in bookmark Y` and is left out
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey's `country` arm appends {tag, id} at +0x98/+0x9C; SaveContents walks +0x94.

struct_fields.name: date
struct_fields.comment: `date`, a tick
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey's `date` arm Date_SetFromString (date in ESI = this + 0xA4); CBookmarkEntry shows FormatHourDate(+0xA4); CGameSetup::SelectBookmark clamps it.

struct_fields.name: is_cgm
struct_fields.comment: `is_cgm`
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey: ParseBool(this + 0xA8); SaveContents writes it.

struct_fields.name: cgm_folder
struct_fields.comment: `cgm_folder`
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey: ParseString(this + 0xAC); SaveContents writes it.

struct_fields.name: next
struct_fields.comment: the next bookmark of its list (file order); +0xC8 the previous
struct_fields.evidence: CBookmarkList_Load: new[0x32] = old tail, old tail +0xCC = new; BuildBookmarkLists walks +0xCC.

struct_fields.name: country
struct_fields.comment: the country to control
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor: +0x3C tag, +0x40 id; Execute's 'Local player will control' names +0x3C.

struct_fields.name: previous
struct_fields.comment: the country the human had (the state's player when posted from the lobby); handed to the AI where no other human holds it
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor: +0x44/+0x48; Execute's 'AI will control' names +0x44 and zeroes played_countries[+0x48].

struct_fields.name: human
struct_fields.comment: the human's id (CHuman +0x1C)
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor: +0x4C = last argument; Execute: FindHumanById(state, +0x4C) and a compare with the session's +0x6C.

struct_fields.name: id
struct_fields.comment: the human's id; the state's humans are found by it
struct_fields.evidence: 0x685E10 walks state +0x60 comparing +0x1C; Update and the command compare it with the lobby's and the session's id.

struct_fields.name: primary_local
struct_fields.comment: logged 'set/unset as primary local' by CSetCountryControllerCommand::Execute
struct_fields.evidence: Execute writes +0x28 = 0 and 1 beside those two log lines.

struct_fields.name: next
struct_fields.comment: the next human of the state's list (+0x60)
struct_fields.evidence: Every walk of state +0x60 in the lobby's code and in 0x685E10 steps through +0x54.

struct_fields.name: controllers_changed
struct_fields.comment: set by CSetCountryControllerCommand::Execute when a country changes hands; the lobby's Update rebuilds its panel and clears it
struct_fields.evidence: Execute stores 1 in two arms; CGameSetup::Update tests and clears it (field_0xc0).

struct_fields.name: controllers_changed
struct_fields.comment: as on CGameState (the record keeps the two apart)
struct_fields.evidence: The same reads and writes on g_CCurrentGameState.

struct_fields.name: lobby_start_requested
struct_fields.comment: set by CLobbyStartGame (CFrontEnd::RequestLobbyStart); CGameSetup::Update starts the game when it is set and CGameSetup_CanStart holds
struct_fields.evidence: Slot 67/68 body `mov byte [ecx+0x764], 1`; Update at 0x70C07B reads [this+4]+0x764.
